notes:
Key ask: dedicated capacity for interactive personalization flows + reranking during live streams.
- Baseline traffic: weekday steady-state ~100 QPS across 12 services (chat + rerank).
- Peak: concurrent live events spike to 1,200 QPS for 3-6 minute windows (bursty, regional).
- Token profile: median 120 tokens/req, 95th ~450 tokens/req — impacts batching and KV-cache sizing.
- Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for chat gen (end-to-end tokens emitted), reranker p95 < 80ms.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to avoid over-commitment; open to hybrid reserved + burst pools.
- Model preference: open to quantized Llama/Redwood variants; will test 8-bit/4-bit profiles.
- Routing: need fallback model variant with lower cost when reserved pool saturated; regional routing mandatory (NA + EU).
- Security: must support SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit logs exported to customer's SIEM.
- Quote request: show 3 sizing scenarios: conservative (steady + 2x headroom), event-optimized (burst buffer), minimal committed (steady only + on-demand).
- "CTO: we cannot degrade live stream recommendations during spikes — need hard fallbacks and clear RTO for failover."
- Links: sample traces and histograms uploaded to Drive (see links).
- Internal champions: Head of ML infra (Julie Park), Product (Marcus Li).
baseline_qps: Steady-state baseline: 100 QPS (aggregate) across chat + rerank services; 12 service shards; per-shard baseline ~8-10 QPS.
baseline_tokens_per_sec: Baseline tokens/sec (avg): ~12k t/s (100 QPS * avg 120 tokens); steady-state sustained. Peak tokens/sec: ~540k t/s during major events (1,200 QPS * 450 tokens at 95th).
peak_traffic_pattern: Short duration extreme bursts (3–6 minutes) during live events; predictable by event schedule but high magnitude. Requires burst buffer and pre-warming strategy; late-binding batching is insufficient alone.
sla_latency_slo: Requested SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for chat gen; p95 < 80ms for reranker. Availability target: 99.95% monthly. Requires rollback and canary + automatic fallback to smaller model variants on degradation.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial proposal requested: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (steady + 1.5x headroom) + configurable burst pool of 12 GPUs; alternate scenario: 12 reserved (event-optimized) with lower per-token cost. Need price delta for 12 vs 8 reserve for 12/24 month terms.
